notes: Page 81: continues day 20 (Abba John Hagir), ¶፱-፲፫, no arke, no day opener. Numerals are small/dotted and inferred from the running sequence (፱ after p80 ¶፰). Resolution is low; many readings uncertain. Ge'ez: ነሢአ (scan reads ንሢአ/ነሢአ, inferred 'he took'); ለለዕለቱ ፪ተ ጊዜ and ፲ወ፪ቱ ምዕራፍ/ዓመት keep the scan's numeral glyphs (Amharic gives 'ሁለት ሁለት ጊዜ', 'ዐሥራ ሁለት'); ወትእኅዘ (scan unclear, maybe ወተእኅዘ); በዝንቱ (scan reads በገዝንቱ-like, inferred); ወአኅዞ (scan unclear, inferred); ወበዘ ኃን (as scanned); ዝክርከ (scan glyph reads ገክርከ-like, inferred ዝክርከ, matches Amharic 'መታሰቢያህ'); ወነሢአ. Amharic: ውኃንን (scan, likely ውኃን), አቄጥቀጠ (scan; maybe አቈጠቈጠ), ብሎ, እንዲ ፈተን (scan; maybe እንዲፈትን), በዙዎችም (scan; likely በብዙዎችም), መነኰሳትን (ኰ restored by convention). Right edges of Amharic lines may be hidden by the binding shadow. PDF cross-check pending.
